description: Delete vectors by IDs or filter criteria. Registered calls return one queued job receipt; read that exact job for the complete operation result.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Admission receipt with job_id and status. The complete original vector operation envelope is in job.result; typed failures are in job.error.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Retain data.job_id and retrieve that exact id with service_interface::job_service::get_job until completed or error before consuming vectors, counts or search results.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Permanently removes vectors from a namespace by ID list or metadata filter criteria
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: some or all vector IDs don't exist. NamespaceError: namespace not found. FilterError: invalid filter syntax. PermissionError: deletion not allowed on protected namespace.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found errors: verify vector IDs exist before deletion. For filter errors: check filter syntax matches supported operators. For permission errors: check if namespace allows deletion. A timeout or lost worker does not authorize retrying uncertain effects; reconcile the exact job and observed namespace state without replay.
